::: {#exr-forward-n-gram-conditional-entropy}
#### Conditional entropy of an $N$-gram model read forward

Let $X_1, X_2, \ldots$ be a [stationary sequence](#def-stationary-sequence)
that is also an [$N$-gram model](#def-n-gram-model) with $N \ge 2$.
For every $t > N$,
show that the forward [conditional entropy](#def-conditional-entropy) of $X_t$ is

$$
\entropyf{X_t \mid X_1, \ldots, X_{t-1}}
= \entropyf{X_1, \ldots, X_N} - \entropyf{X_1, \ldots, X_{N-1}}.
$$

:::
